title: Runbook
description: Structured runbook for an agent-executed workflow: trigger conditions, scope/approval rules, ordered phases, decision matrix, invocation modes, category shortcuts, integrations with other agents/skills, worked examples, and anti-patterns.

schemaId.description: Self-describing schema reference. Must equal the schema's $id.

title.description: Short display name for the runbook (kebab-case slug or human title).

summary.description: One or two sentences describing what the runbook does.

trigger.description: Conditions under which an agent should invoke this runbook.

scope.description: Default access posture and the conditions that require explicit user approval.

phases.description: Ordered phases of the runbook. Each phase is one logical step the agent executes.

decisionMatrix.description: Signal-to-action mapping the agent consults at decision points within the runbook.

modes.description: Alternative invocation profiles (e.g., quick inline checklist vs. delegated subagent).

shortcuts.description: Category-grouped lookups the agent can consult during the runbook (e.g., known libraries by domain).

integrations.description: How this runbook composes with other agents or skills.

examples.description: Worked examples showing the runbook applied to concrete situations.

antiPatterns.description: Known failure modes the agent should actively avoid while running the runbook.

extensions.description: Open extension hatch for doc-specific structure that doesn't fit the closed core.

default.description: One-sentence description of the default access posture (e.g., 'read-only research').

approvalRequired.description: Conditions that require explicit user approval before the agent acts.

description.description: What happens in this phase, in one or two sentences.

substeps.description: Optional ordered sub-actions within the phase.

signal.description: The observable condition that triggers this rule.

action.description: What the agent should do when the signal is present.

whenToUse.description: When this mode is the right choice.

steps.description: Ordered actions the agent performs in this mode.

delegateTo.description: Optional subagent or skill to delegate to (e.g., 'researcher subagent').

need.description: What the agent is trying to do (e.g., 'Linting').

candidates.description: Known options that satisfy the need.

with.description: The other agent, skill, or runbook this composes with.

howToCombine.description: How the composition works in practice.

name.description: Short label for the example (e.g., 'Add dead link checking').

need.description: The concrete need the example addresses.

found.description: The top candidate(s) the search surfaced.

action.description: The decision and the approval / implementation step.

result.description: The outcome after applying the action.

name.description: Short label for the anti-pattern (e.g., 'Jumping to code').

description.description: Why this is harmful and what to do instead.
